args.description: Training table for Retail Win-back with only the customers' orders from the United Kingdom: one row per shopper active on or before the snapshot, behaviour measured on or before it, and reactivated = 1 when the shopper ordered again in the 60 days after the snapshot.
args.sql:
WITH rows_uk AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, InvoiceNo, CAST(InvoiceDate AS DATE) AS d, Quantity * UnitPrice AS amount
  FROM t_order_log
  WHERE Country = 'United Kingdom' AND CustomerID IS NOT NULL
),
before AS (
  SELECT CustomerID,
         date_diff('day', max(d), $as_of) AS days_since_last_order,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d > $as_of - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN InvoiceNo END) AS orders_90d,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d > $as_of - INTERVAL '365' DAY THEN InvoiceNo END) AS orders_365d,
         coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN d > $as_of - INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN amount END), 0) AS spend_90d,
         coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN d > $as_of - INTERVAL '365' DAY THEN amount END), 0) AS spend_365d,
         sum(amount) / nullif(count(DISTINCT InvoiceNo), 0) AS avg_order_value
  FROM rows_uk
  WHERE d <= $as_of
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
after AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
  FROM rows_uk
  WHERE d > $as_of AND d <= $as_of + INTERVAL '60' DAY
)
SELECT b.CustomerID, b.days_since_last_order, b.orders_90d, b.orders_365d, b.spend_90d, b.spend_365d,
       b.avg_order_value, CASE WHEN a.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS reactivated
FROM before b LEFT JOIN after a ON a.CustomerID = b.CustomerID
